shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'DropdownMenu.*(d.ts|js)"'$'"' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']) { try { console.log(p,import.meta.resolve(p)) } catch {} }\" && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js && cat index.html && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"const [tab,setTab] = useState('all');\", \"const [tab,setTab] = useState('all');\\n  const [openMenu,setOpenMenu] = useState<string|null>(null);\")
s=s.replace(\"<DropdownMenu items={actions(doc)} size=\\\"l\\\"\", \"<DropdownMenu open={openMenu===doc.id} onOpenToggle={open=>setOpenMenu(open?doc.id:null)} items={actions(doc)} size=\\\"l\\\"\")
s=s.replace('aria-haspopup=\"menu\">Действия', 'aria-haspopup=\"menu\" aria-expanded={openMenu===doc.id}>Действия')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/styles.css';s=open(p).read().replace('color:#9a a48f;','');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='index.html';s=open(p).read().replace('lang=\"en\"','lang=\"ru\"').replace('<title>Gravity UI eval</title>','<meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"#f3f5f0\" />\\n    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"Контур — пространство для ваших документов, мыслей и планов.\" />\\n    <title>Документы — Контур</title>');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/bin/chrom* /opt/google/chrome/* /tmp/*playwright* 2>/dev/null; git status --short; npm run build'
